items.title: Jalen Duren has the same agent as Tari Eason, who recently turned down a 5-year $100 million contract and eventually signed a 5-year $81.5 million deal
items.author: Easy-Philosopher-562
items.body_excerpt: The agent's name is Chafie Fields. He has a handful of clients and Duren and Eason are the only two basketball players he represents. Some of his NFL clients: Geno Smith Arik Armstead JuJu Smith-Schuster Cam Robinson Brevin Jordan Jalen Nailor Nohl Williams His instagram handle…
